description: Numeric field. Carries DefaultValue (as a STRING, not a JSON number) and Decimalpoint — both per-type defaults the builder writes that the bare API does not require.
notes: DefaultValue is the STRING "0", not the number 0 — the whole node graph is JSON but several numeric-looking fields (this, MaxRow's sibling Padding on SequenceNumber) are wire strings.
Decimalpoint:"2" is itself a string holding a digit count, not a boolean/flag.
